tip.start: Your goal is on the act card: do what it says to move the story on. The agenda is the clock: when doom fills it, things get worse.
tip.phoneTap: On a phone, tap a card or a room to look at it, and tap it again to choose it. Hold your finger on a card to see it full size.
tip.mulligan: This is your starting hand. Tap the cards you don't want to swap them for new ones, or keep the hand as it is.
tip.turn: Your turn: you have 3 actions. Search, move, draw, take a resource or play a card, each costs one. The bar shows how many are left.
tip.investigate: Clues are hidden in rooms. Tap Investigate, or your room, to search for one. The room's shroud, how hard it is to search, is the number to beat.
tip.move: To go somewhere else, drag your portrait to a room joined to yours. Moving takes 1 action.
tip.play: A glowing card in your hand can be played. The number in its top corner is its cost in resources.
tip.test: A skill test: your skill against the difficulty. To add to your skill, tap cards whose icons match the test, then Done.
tip.token: Tap a circle to draw a chaos token. It changes your skill: a number adds or takes away, a symbol has its own effect.
tip.enemy: An enemy is with you. Fight it to deal damage, or evade it to slip away. If it is still with you in the enemy phase, it attacks.
tip.damage: Damage lowers your health, horror lowers your sanity. If either reaches zero, you are out of this scenario.
tip.mythos: Mythos: doom goes on the agenda and each investigator draws an encounter card, something bad from the scenario.
tip.upkeep: Upkeep: your cards get ready, you draw a card and gain a resource. You may keep at most 8 cards in your hand.
tip.endTurn: No actions left. Tap End turn so the next investigator can play.
tip.undo: Changed your mind? Undo takes back your last choice, until a card or a chaos token has been revealed.
howto.title: How to play
howto.goal.title: The goal
howto.goal.text: You play together against the game. The act card says what to do to move the story on. The agenda is the clock: doom gathers on it every round. Finish the acts before the agenda runs out.
howto.round.title: A round
howto.round.text: Each round has four phases. Mythos: doom is added and everyone draws an encounter card. Investigation: each investigator takes a turn. Enemy: hunters move and enemies attack. Upkeep: cards get ready, everyone draws a card and takes a resource.
howto.turn.title: Your turn
howto.turn.text: You have 3 actions. Search your room for clues, move to a joined room, draw a card, take a resource, play a card from your hand, or fight or evade an enemy. Then end your turn.
howto.tests.title: Skill tests
howto.tests.text: Many actions are tests: your skill against a difficulty. Add cards from your hand whose icons match, then draw a chaos token from the bag. It changes your total. Equal or higher succeeds.
howto.enemies.title: Enemies and harm
howto.enemies.text: An enemy in your room engages you and attacks in the enemy phase. Fight it to defeat it, or evade it to slip away. Damage lowers your health, horror lowers your sanity; at zero you are out of the scenario.

kw.hunter.name: Hunter
kw.hunter: During the enemy phase, a ready, unengaged Hunter enemy moves one location toward the nearest investigator. If several are nearest, its Prey decides.
kw.retaliate.name: Retaliate
kw.retaliate: When an investigator fails a skill test while attacking this ready enemy, it attacks that investigator after the test. It does not exhaust.
kw.alert.name: Alert
kw.alert: When an investigator fails a skill test while evading this enemy, it attacks that investigator after the test. It does not exhaust.
kw.aloof.name: Aloof
kw.aloof: This enemy does not engage investigators at its location on its own. Engage it with the engage action (or a card) before you can attack it.
kw.massive.name: Massive
kw.massive: This ready enemy is engaged with every investigator at its location and attacks each of them in the enemy phase. It cannot be moved into a threat area.
kw.surge.name: Surge
kw.surge: After resolving this encounter card, draw another encounter card.
kw.peril.name: Peril
kw.peril: While resolving this encounter card, you may not talk with the other players, and they cannot play cards, trigger abilities or commit cards to your tests.
kw.fast.name: Fast
kw.fast: Playing this card takes no action. A Fast event can be played at any time its text allows; a Fast asset during your turn.
kw.patrol.name: Patrol
kw.patrol: During the enemy phase, a ready, unengaged Patrol enemy moves one location toward the location its keyword names.
kw.elusive.name: Elusive
kw.elusive: After this enemy attacks or is attacked, it disengages, exhausts and moves to a connecting location with no investigators, if it can.
kw.swarming.name: Swarming
kw.swarming: When this enemy spawns, the top cards of the lead investigator's deck (the number after the keyword) are placed facedown beneath it as swarm cards, each a copy of it.
kw.concealed.name: Concealed
kw.concealed: This enemy enters play hidden among concealed mini-cards; investigators must expose it at a location before they can engage or attack it.
kw.exceptional.name: Exceptional
kw.exceptional: Costs twice its level in experience, and a deck may hold only one copy.
kw.myriad.name: Myriad
kw.myriad: A deck may hold up to three copies of this card by title; buying the first copy brings the others for free.
kw.bonded.name: Bonded
kw.bonded: Not part of your deck: these cards are set aside with the card they are bonded to and enter play only through its effects.
kw.permanent.name: Permanent
kw.permanent: Starts each scenario in play, does not count toward deck size, and can't be discarded.
kw.seal.name: Seal
kw.seal: When this card enters play, a chaos token it names is taken from the bag and sealed on it until it leaves play or the token is released.
kw.uses.name: Uses
kw.uses: Enters play with that many tokens of the named kind (ammo, supplies, charges, secrets…), spent to pay for its abilities.
kw.victory.name: Victory
kw.victory: When this card leaves play through the investigators' actions it goes to the victory display; at the end of the scenario its victory points are experience.
